This '''man''' was among the sizable construction crew of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] incomplete [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] saboteurs, including [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], jumped this man and a fellow worker, [[Brunok]], while on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hockaleg]] and stole their construction uniforms, enabling them to sneak aboard and eventually destroy the ''Tarkin''.
